author: MikeL501
quote: Rockstar lied to everyone. They lied just to sell off this "thing" as quickly as possible—a product completely devoid of the GTA spirit. You’re nothing but a slave on a leash, serving your mistress. You can’t shoot whoever you want; you can’t steal whatever car you want. This isn’t GTA. It’s a piece of fan fiction written by a group of women who dream of having a subservient slave like this. No thanks, Rockstar. Choke on this cuckold-fest yourselves. Dan Houser knew what was going to happen to his brainchild, so he jumped ship—he knew exactly how bad this game would turn out. SHAME ON YOU, ROCKSTAR.

author: MikeL501
quote: I give it a big 0. Why? Because of Ubisoft's "hyena greed" and throwing micro transactions into the game for $70. The game is boring, tedious and hard to achieve anything in it. Do you need to find temples where you progress? Pay $10 and we'll clear the map for you and you'll find them faster. The entire structure of the game forces us to pay extra money. Is Ubisoft trying to make money with tricks like these? And Yasuke and the whole woke agenda are the final nail in the coffin. I hope they buy you out though. I don't feel sorry for you. Where is the company that created AC2? It's gone and never will be, it's just a corporation that feeds on players' money like a hyena.
